name: recent-orders-card
title: Recent orders card
description: The latest orders as a dashboard widget: number, customer, date, status in an icon and a word, and the total. A real table that stacks on phones.
docs: Totals are in major units. Pressing an order number runs `onOpen`; call `event.preventDefault()` there to route yourself instead of following `href`. Below 672px of card width the table turns into stacked rows. A long name or address ends in an ellipsis, with the full text in a title, so the total never leaves the card.
